title: There is never a bad time for Cake
description: A curated resource pack bringing pastel rainbow accents and cozy visual polish to your Minecraft HUD, blocks, and world.
body:
There is never a bad time for Cake is a carefully curated resource pack built around a soft pastel rainbow visual identity.

Every element of the HUD has been considered — custom destroy stages that sweep through a pastel rainbow as blocks break, a matching XP bar, cake hunger icons, rainbow heart containers, a soft lavender hotbar selector, and pastel enchant glint on your gear.

Bundled with a handpicked selection of Vanilla Tweaks including varied textures across dozens of block types, directional hoppers and dispensers, beehive honey stages, fancy sunflowers, and 25 unique carved pumpkin faces from the 2025 Pumpkin Carving Competition.

Designed to be shader friendly and tuned specifically for Complementary Reimagined — fully functional and beautiful as a standalone experience, and the visual companion to an upcoming modpack.

Free to use in modpacks, on servers, and in content creation with attribution. Please credit CleverRuse and link back to this page.
